verses.text: On day eight, Moses called Aaron, his sons, and Israel’s elders together.
He told Aaron, “Take a calf from the herd for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering. Both must be free of defects. Offer them before Yahweh.
Tell the Israelites, ‘Bring a male goat for a sin offering. For a burnt offering, bring a calf and a lamb, each a year old and free of defects.
Bring a bull and a ram to sacrifice as peace offerings before Yahweh, and bring a grain offering mixed with oil. Today Yahweh is going to appear to you.’”
They brought everything Moses had asked for to the front of the Tent of Meeting. The whole community came forward and stood before Yahweh.
Moses said, “Do what Yahweh has commanded, and you’ll see his glory.”

Moses told Aaron, “Go up to the altar. Give your sin offering and burnt offering to make atonement for yourself and the people. Then bring the people’s offering and make atonement for them, just as Yahweh told us.”
Aaron went up to the altar and slaughtered the calf for his own sin offering.
His sons handed him the blood. He dipped his finger in it and put some on the horns of the altar, then poured the blood out at its base.
He burned the fat, the kidneys, and the piece covering the liver on the altar, just as Yahweh had told Moses.
He took the meat and the hide outside the camp and burned them there.
Aaron slaughtered the animal for the burnt offering. His sons handed him the blood, and he splashed it against all sides of the altar.
They handed him the pieces and the head, and he burned them on the altar.
He washed the insides and legs and burned them on top of the burnt offering on the altar.
Then Aaron brought the people’s offering. He took the goat for their sin offering, slaughtered it, and offered it for their sin the same way he’d offered the first one.
He brought the burnt offering and followed the rules for offering it.
He brought the grain offering, scooped up a handful, and burned it on the altar in addition to the morning’s burnt offering.
Aaron slaughtered the bull and the ram for the people’s peace offerings. His sons handed him the blood, and he splashed it against all sides of the altar.
They also brought the fat from the bull and the ram, including the fat tail, the fat covering the insides, the kidneys, and the piece covering the liver.
They laid the fat on top of the breasts, and Aaron burned the fat on the altar.
Aaron waved the breasts and the right thigh before Yahweh as a wave offering, just as Moses had commanded.
Aaron raised his hands toward the people and blessed them. Then he came down after making the sin offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offerings.
Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of Meeting. When they came back out, they blessed the people, and everyone saw Yahweh’s glory.
Fire came from before Yahweh and burned up the burnt offering and the fat on the altar. 🔥 When the people saw it, they shouted and fell facedown.
